revision_notes: Stronger, more current evidence supports Code 4 despite two of the three original sources being irrelevant (a hackathon overview) or fabricated (a32i-botswana.onrender.com, an AI-generated content-mill page). Botswana has enacted the Digital Services Act (No. 22 of 2025), establishing a Digital Services Authority mandated to produce a Digital Government Plan and a 'standardised Framework for Secure Exchange of Information' ensuring interoperability; the ongoing EU-funded Expertise France project (to 2027) explicitly works to 'improve and align' an existing National Interoperability Framework; and the 1Gov-1Citizen platform (expanded from 33 to 52 e-services in the 2026/27 financial year, per TechAfrica News, March 2026) is the operational vehicle for this. Code 4 (Comprehensive Strategy Exists) confirmed on this stronger, current evidence base.
